name: M-Winch Fits 14" Diameter Flagpole White
description: This internal halyard M-winch is designed to fit a 14" diameter pole. It is available in 5 different finishes. The maintenance-free M-winch is gearless and self-locking at any point, eliminating the need for a separate brake. It is a direct drive winch that provides rapid rising and lowering of the flag with little effort. Welding is not required, monthly lubrication isn't necessary and it can easily be adapted to on-site flagpoles. This winch gets inserted into the pole and secured with a stainless steel bolt on the back side of the pole.
